title: Show HN: Ant – A JavaScript runtime and ecosystem
summary: Ant is an ambitious JavaScript ecosystem project featuring a custom JavaScript runtime with its own engine, package manager, hosting platform, and Ant Desktop for building native desktop apps similar to Electron. The project aims to provide a unified, all-in-one platform while maintaining compatibility with the wider JavaScript ecosystem.
problem_solved: Provides a complete, integrated JavaScript development platform combining runtime, package management, hosting, and desktop app development in one ecosystem.
why_valuable: Offers developers a cohesive alternative to assembling multiple tools (Node.js, npm, hosting services, Electron) with better integration and a unified experience.
